title: A Thorn for the Ember Revisited
author: I. M. Blackwood
blurb: Petra Okonkwo, a royal food-taster building immunity one dish at a time, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
